notes:
For the CEO and MD: a new "Go To" on Home, under Quick actions. Pick any date and everything on it shows right below — events, holidays, birthdays and anniversaries, your interviews, reminders, task deadlines, who is on leave, last working days and people joining. The separate "On leave" card is gone from the CEO/MD Home. The same calendar is on the website dashboard too.

Birthdays and anniversaries now appear only in the 7 days before the day.

Reports and other documents always open fresh — the phone no longer shows an older copy of the same PDF.

Home loads faster: the punch card comes first, and coming back to Home no longer reloads everything.

Also: the in-app Help guide is updated.
